BTS Group wins Sustainability Disclosure Award 2021
BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited (BTS Group) received the Thaipat Institute Sustainability Disclosure Award 2021 in recognition of its excellent public disclosure of company performances and coverage of its Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) aspects in the BTS Group Sustainability Report.
BTS Group has been selected as fourth-time DJSI index component and become second-time “DJSI INDUSTRY LEADER” for Transportation and Transportation Infrastructure

BTS Group has been selected as an index component of the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices (DJSI) 2020 in the DJSI Emerging Markets for fourth consecutive years. BTS Group is the only Thai rail transportation Company ranked amongst world class DJSI Indices members. According this year’s evaluated performances, BTS Group continues the second-time “DJSI INDUSTRY LEADER” for Transportation and Transportation Infrastructure Industry.

BTS Group achieved “Excellent” Corporate Governance for the 10th consecutive year by The Thai Institute of Directors Association

BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited has been assessed as “Excellent” in Corporate Governance for ten consecutive years by The Thai Institute of Directors Association (IOD), with support from the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET). The IOD assessed a total of 716 Thai listed companies in the Corporate Governance Report of Thai Listed Companies 2021. This showcases the Company’s commitment to business growth on the basis of good governance and sustainable development, taking into account the interests of all stakeholders involved.

In addition, BTS Group has been awarded and recognised on its sustainability-related performance both nationally and internationally. Besides our emphasis on corporate governance, this represents the Company’s commitment to reducing environmental impact and supporting community development and economic growth. It also demonstrates the Company’s resilience while maintaining good sustainability practices, even in challenging and rapidly changing economic conditions during the economic crisis caused by the COVID-19 pandemic.

BTS Group renewed the third-time Certified Company of Thailand’s Private Sector Collective Action Coalition Against Corruption

On 20 July 2021, BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited was awarded with a renewal of certification of membership of Thailand’s Private Sector Collective Action Coalition Against Corruption by the Thailand’s Private Sector Collective Action Coalition Against Corruption Council for the third consecutive time. This showcases the Company’s explicit measures against fraud and corruption.

BTS Group – The first and only rail transportation company certified as carbon neutral

We are honoured to be the first and only rail carbon neutral transportation company (certified by the Thai Government’s Thailand Greenhouse Gas Management Organisation). This achievement was as a result of BTS Group’s sustainable business plan and ongoing efforts to reduce emissions, coupled with the implementation of carbon offsetting schemes by joining a carbon credit programme with Mitr Phol Bio-Power project. This collaboration reflects our commitment to sustainably mitigate the impact of climate change, at the same time enabling Thailand to achieve its nationally determined contribution to reduce greenhouse gases in accordance with the Paris Climate Agreement.

BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited was ranked “SAM Gold Class”

BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited was ranked “SAM Gold Class” distinction, for Transportation and Transportation Infrastructure Industry, assessed by S&P Global. This ranking has been announced in The Sustainability Yearbook 2021, in which provides the ranking of the 630 sustainability leaders selected, based on their S&P Global ESG Scores, from over 7,000 companies assessed worldwide.
